management_steps.details: Adult: Alvarado Score (RIF migratory pain [1], anorexia [1], nausea [1], RIF tenderness [2], rebound [1], fever [1], leukocytosis [2], left shift [1]). Paediatric (3-18 yrs): PAS score (cough/hopping tenderness [2], RLQ tenderness [2], anorexia [1], fever [1], nausea [1], WBC > 10 [1], neutrophilia [1], migratory pain [1]).
ABCD. Bolus fluids 20 ml/kg if hypovolaemic. If septic shock present: give Augmentin 30mg/kg IV, and arrange urgent surgical consult. Give Morphine 0.1mg/kg IV for pain.
